description: Retained attempt-8/9 NPF-1 NEGATIVE fixture: the four real Round-B `merge.landed` product event lines from the retained attempt-8 STORM-REHEARSAL campaign, where every landing was `noop:true` with `checkoutRefresh: "already-coherent"` (the shared-branch shape of NPF-1 — the product landed NOTHING and never had to park around the B-park dirt).
